definitions.explanation: Suspicion of having committed a crime. A legal and news term used to describe the grounds on which someone is arrested or investigated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窃盗|せっとう}→窃盗：15280_settou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{容疑|ようぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested on suspicion of theft.

examples.japanese: {容疑|ようぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{否認|ひにん}している→否認する：22511_hininsuru⟧。
examples.english: The suspect is denying the charges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{容疑|ようぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{指名手配|しめいてはい}→指名手配：18897_shimeitehai⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{身柄|みがら}→身柄：18826_migara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A man who was wanted on suspicion of fraud was apprehended at the airport.

notes:
{容疑|ようぎ} combines {容|よう} (appearance, suspicion) and {疑|ぎ} (doubt, suspicion). It is a legal term frequently seen in news reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容疑|ようぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}される→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧ (to be arrested on suspicion of)
- {容疑|ようぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{否認|ひにん}する→否認する：22511_hininsuru⟧ (to deny the charges)
- {容疑|ようぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ (to admit to the charges)
- {容疑|ようぎ}{者|しゃ} (suspect — a very common compound)
- ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{容疑|ようぎ} (suspicion of murder)

USAGE:
The pattern 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{容疑|ようぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (on suspicion of ~) is extremely common in crime reporting. {容疑|ようぎ}{者|しゃ} (suspect) is the standard term used in Japanese media for a person who has been arrested but not yet convicted.
